newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen shares close lower on correction.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen shares close lower on correction.

text.p: Shenzhen's A and B share indices ended lower on Tuesday on a correction after rises for three successive sessions, brokers said.
The B share index lost 3.03 points or 2.09 percent to close at 141.98 on volume of 11.12 million shares worth HK$52.12 million compared with Monday's HK$77.56 million.
The A share index fell 8.43 points or 2.43 percent to end at 338.51 on turnover of 4.36 billion yuan against 5.20 billion yuan the previous session.
Brokers said market sentiment was also pressured by reports in the official media that China had no immediate plans to ease credit controls.

The China Securities newspaper on Tuesday quoted the central bank head Dai Xianglong as saying at an ongoing national financial meeting in Beijing that China will maintain its relatively tight monetary policy in 1997.
"Rumours over the past few sessions that a further cut in bank interest rates could be announced at the meeting had pushed up share prices," a trader said.
The indices are likely to fluctuate in a limited range in the coming sessions and institutions will forego large-scale trading unless there is fresh, major market-moving news, brokers said.

On the A share market, Shaanxi International Trust became the biggest loser with a fall of 0.78 yuan or 7.00 percent to 10.37 yuan. Xinjiang Hongyuan Trust followed, slumping 0.67 yuan or 6.16 percent to 10.20 yuan.
Hotelier Dadonghai was the worst B share performer, declining HK$0.17 or 4.57 percent to HK$3.55 on the session's heaviest volume of 1.52 million shares on profit-taking.
Beverage maker Shenbao dropped HK$0.20 or 4.21 percent to HK$4.55 on trade of 218,400 shares. Health Mineral Water ebbed HK$0.19 or 4.02 percent to HK$4.54 after 296,420 shares changed hands.
Changan Automobile traded the second most on volume of 1.21 million shares, slipping HK$0.12 to HK$4.49.
